mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, it is 58 degrees and overcast near the Verona Public Library. The moon is in its third quarter phase. Tonight, the temperature will dip to a low of 51 degrees with no rain predicted.

October is now Community Planning Month in Verona, recognizing the Planning and Development Department for their hard work. Also, please note that the Fireman's Park Beach is now closed for the season, though the splash pad remains a highlight during the summer months.

Tomorrow is a busy day in the community! You can catch live music at Bailey's Run, explore the trade show at the World Dairy Expo, or participate in the annual apple cider pressing at the Farley Center.
On September 24, officers responded to a collision between a vehicle and an 11-year-old cyclist at Westward Drive and Jenna Drive. The child was assessed by EMS and did not require hospitalization.
Today's flavor, Really Reese's, has come to an end. Culver's is currently closed, but will reopen tomorrow morning at 10:00 AM, featuring the Andes Mint Avalanche as the flavor of the day.
